shaders.reason: No kernel change. Prefill skip is a host encode-graph choice (omit lm_head + argmax dispatches). Encoder labels are host Metal API calls.

finding: The complete-vs-decode gap is teacher-forced prefill amortized over generated tokens, not command-buffer or encoder ceremony. Interphase is not the quarter. Serial-encoder ceremony was already attacked and did not separate. Decode TPS is L40/L41 territory. Removable work that was still on the prefill path: lm_head+argmax on non-emitting prompt steps, and production encoder labels without a physical probe.
gaps_closed: Non-emitting prefill no longer runs lm_head + argmax.
Production TokenCommandBuffer dispatches no longer set_label without a physical-trace probe.
Serial-encoder and skip-terminal env levers refuse unrecognised values instead of silently falling through.

lm_head_skip.claim_boundary: Arithmetic on the catalog shapes, not a measured GPU duration. The skip is bit-identity-preserving if lm_head/argmax do not write KV or DeltaNet; they write logits and sampled only.

negative_findings: Serial compute encoder covering the token graph did not separate complete-wall (GPU_IDLE_GAP_LEDGER, 7 reps, overlapping ranges).
A removed dispatch that moves no extra bytes is ~1 us (ACCELERATOR_DISPATCH_IS_NOT_THE_PRICE). Removing hundreds of encoder creates is not the 25% complete-vs-decode gap.
wall − prefill − decode (interphase) is not a quarter of complete-token time; it is the Instant gap between two loops.

quoted_gap.reading: complete/decode = generated / (prompt_len + generated - 1) when every step costs the same and interphase is zero. 13 and 40 give 40/52 = 0.769, and 0.769 * 35.5 = 27.3, which is the quoted 27.2. The quarter is teacher-forced prefill.

dispatch_price.reading: G079 carried an open question: why does a synthetic arm price a removed dispatch at 8.6 us while production prices the gate_up pair at 17.35 us. The answer is that NEITHER NUMBER IS A DISPATCH PRICE. 'us per removed dispatch' silently bundles the dispatch overhead with whatever WORK moved when the dispatch was removed, and on this machine the work dominates by two orders of magnitude.
